title: Velocity Config Generator | Minecraft Proxy Forwarding Helper
description: Generate safe starter Velocity proxy config snippets, backend server entries, and Paper forwarding settings for a Minecraft network.
intro: Build starter config snippets for a Velocity proxy network, including backend server entries, modern forwarding, and the Paper settings that must match it.
howTo: Enter the public proxy bind address players connect to.
Enter the backend server name and address exactly as Velocity should see it.
Use a private forwarding secret and put the same value in Velocity and your Paper backend.
Keep backend Minecraft ports closed from the public internet whenever possible.
faqs: Should backend servers be online-mode false?
With a Velocity proxy, backend servers normally run behind the proxy and must be configured for Velocity player information forwarding. Do not expose trusted backend ports publicly.
No. It helps forward identity safely, but you should still firewall backend servers.
Can this replace the official Velocity docs?
No. It gives a starter snippet and checklist. Always compare with the current PaperMC Velocity docs before going live.
